symptoms: Brown spots can develop on tomato leaves.
Spots may show concentric ring patterns.
Disease can cause affected leaves to yellow and die.
management: Remove and destroy severely affected plant material.
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness where possible.

symptoms: Small brown spots can develop on tomato leaves.
Leaf spots may have yellow halos.
Severe disease can cause affected leaves to drop.
Water-soaked spots can develop on green fruits.
management: Remove and destroy severely affected plant material.
